newsitem.title: USA: Tosco sets stock split, dividend increase.
newsitem.headline: Tosco sets stock split, dividend increase.

text.p: Tosco Corp said on Monday it plans a three-for-one stock split and that will raise its quarterly dividend.
The dividend will be increased to $0.06 per post-split share, or $0.18 per pre-split share, Tosco said. Tosco's previous quarterly dividend was $0.17 a share.
The stock split is subject to the approval by Tosco's shareholders of an increase in the number of authorized but unissued shares at a meeting to be held February 12, 1997.
Tosco said the record date for the split will be February 13, 1997, with a distribution date for the split shares to be February 25, 1997.
The company has not yet declared the dividend, but the new rate is expected at the end of March, a company spokesman said.
